provenance.owner_direction: 2026-10-26: ask where the person works the first time, then remember it

rationale: Turn 1: ask where the person works (or which city) instead of guessing a place; trying a lookup first is tolerated only if she then asks. Turn 2 '我在上海上班。': read Shanghai's weather for tomorrow morning and say whether to bring an umbrella. Turn 3 '那下班的时候呢？': Shanghai's weather for tomorrow evening, without asking for the city again.
